name: Receipt Queue Drainer (Ollama Vision)
description: Schedule-triggered drainer. Each tick: list queue/ oldest-first (FIFO), atomically claim the oldest job with move-file (lock-free mutual exclusion — overlapping ticks never double-process), read it, run the receipt image through a local Ollama vision model, persist the extracted JSON to receipts/, notify the original sender on WhatsApp, then delete the job. Processes one receipt per tick for steady, effectively-serial throughput regardless of how fast photos arrive.

nodes.name: List queue
nodes.description: Enumerate queued jobs, oldest first → FIFO.

nodes.name: Claim oldest
nodes.description: Atomic claim: move queue/<job> into processing/. moved:false means another tick already took it — lock-free.

nodes.name: Resolve image URL
nodes.description: The job stores the bridge's CONTAINER path (/app/media/...), which the engine can't open. The engine serves the same file by basename at /media/<name>, and ollama-vision accepts an http(s) URL. So derive the basename and build a fetchable URL — works for old jobs (image/media path) and new ones (basename).

nodes.name: Extract receipt
nodes.description: Run the receipt photo through a local vision LLM and return structured JSON. Model is the {{variables.model}} workflow variable — swap it in one place. image is the engine's own /media URL; the node fetches and base64-encodes it.

config.system: You are a precise receipt-OCR engine. Read the receipt image and return ONLY a single minified JSON object, no prose, no markdown fences.
config.prompt: Extract these fields from this receipt photo. Use null when a field is not visible. Return strictly this JSON shape: {"merchant":string|null,"date":string|null,"time":string|null,"currency":string|null,"total":number|null,"tax":number|null,"payment_method":string|null,"items":[{"name":string,"qty":number|null,"price":number|null}]}

nodes.name: Save result
nodes.description: Store the extracted receipt JSON under receipts/ for the next stage / bookkeeping.

nodes.name: Notify sender
nodes.description: Send the extracted details back to whoever sent the photo (stored in the job).

nodes.name: Remove job
nodes.description: Job complete — delete the claimed job file from processing/.

nodes.name: Queue empty
nodes.description: Nothing to do this tick — terminate quietly.

config.message: Drainer tick: queue empty, nothing to process.

nodes.name: Lost the claim
nodes.description: Another overlapping tick already claimed this job — stop, it will process it.

config.message: Drainer tick: lost race for {{outputs["ls"].files[0].name}} (claimed by another run). Stopping.
